name: Aaron Khodami, PhD
description: Aaron studies vision, visual attention, eye tracking, and cognitive behaviour at the University of Jyväskylä. He works with the Drive-in-lab group and holds a PhD from the University of Padua.

name: António Correia
description: António is a postdoctoral researcher in the Faculty of Information Technology at the University of Jyväskylä. His publications explore human–computer interaction, collaborative technologies, and artificial intelligence.

name: Laura Mononen
description: Laura is a university teacher in the Faculty of Information Technology at the University of Jyväskylä. Her research explores systems thinking, adult cognitive development, and human–technology interaction design.

name: Tommi Kärkkäinen
description: Tommi is a professor at the University of Jyväskylä. His research develops ways to process and use large, sparse, heterogeneous, and noisy data in collaboration with partners across different fields.
